contea di ritrovamento: Dorset (Inghilterra e Galles)

A cast copper alloy Hod Hill type bow brooch, probably dating from the 1st century AD. The brooch has been bent out of shape (it is now 59.05mm in length) and the pin is missing but it is otherwise in good condition with a mid bluish-green patina.
